profileText: a Representative from Kansas; born in Quinter, Gove County, Kans., December 17, 1976; graduated from Quinter High School, Quinter, Kans.; B.A., Kansas State University, Manhattan, Kans., 2000; commercial real estate broker; unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the One Hundred Twelfth Congress in 2010; appointed Kansas state lieutenant governor, 2018-2019; unsuccessful candidate for nomination for Kansas state lieutenant governor in 2019; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021-present).
